security_audit.summary: The audit confirms the pipe-to-shell installer command in SKILL.md line 14 and its associated network URL as the real security issue. Other static hits are Markdown code fences, parameter tables, sample infsh commands, SDK examples, or documentation links that do not execute automatically. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl-to-shell quick start with manual download, checksum verification, and a separate execution step.

remediation.issue: Installer trust path in quick start
remediation.suggestion: Make manual verification the default path and ask users to inspect the installer before running it.
State clearly that prompts and image URLs are sent to inference.sh and may use Google Search when enabled.

content.user_title: Generate Gemini Images with Nano Banana 2
content.value_statement: Image teams need fast ways to create and edit visual concepts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through inference.sh image generation workflows.
actual_capabilities: Runs the inference.sh CLI for the Gemini Flash image preview app.
Edits images when users provide supported image inputs.
Requests multiple images and common aspect ratios through documented options.
Supports higher resolution requests up to 4K when the model accepts them.
Can enable Google Search grounding for current information prompts.
limitations: Requires an installed and authenticated inference.sh CLI.
Sends prompts and image inputs to inference.sh and model providers.
Model availability, pricing, and output quality depend on external services.
The skill does not verify copyright, identity, or policy compliance for generated images.

use_cases.title: Create concept art
use_cases.description: Generate visual directions for products, scenes, characters, or campaigns before production work begins.

use_cases.title: Produce campaign visuals
use_cases.description: Create multiple image options with consistent mood, format, and style for marketing drafts.

use_cases.title: Prototype image workflows
use_cases.description: Test Gemini image generation and editing through CLI and SDK examples before integration.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Nano Banana 2 to create one photorealistic image of [subject] with [style] and [aspect ratio].

prompt_templates.title: Edit an existing image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Nano Banana 2 to edit my provided image. Change [element], preserve [elements], and return [number] options.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a campaign set
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Nano Banana 2 to create four images for [campaign]. Use consistent colors, mood, and aspect ratio.

prompt_templates.title: Ground a current scene
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Nano Banana 2 with Google Search grounding to visualize [current event or location]. Include realistic details and note assumptions.

output_examples.input: Create a photorealistic image of a banana in space.
output_examples.output: The skill requests one photorealistic image through inference.sh and returns generated image assets with a short description.

output_examples.input: Add a rainbow to my landscape image while keeping the scene natural.
output_examples.output: The skill submits the provided image for editing and returns revised image options that preserve the original scene.

output_examples.input: Create four 16:9 images for a coffee shop campaign.
output_examples.output: The skill requests four wide-format campaign images with consistent visual direction and model-provided descriptions.

best_practices: Install the inference.sh CLI from a verified source before using the skill.
Use specific prompts with subject, style, composition, lighting, and aspect ratio.
Review generated images for accuracy, rights, and safety before publication.
anti_patterns: Do not paste secrets or private customer data into image prompts.
Do not use remote image URLs unless you have permission to process them.
Do not rely on grounded results as a factual source without independent verification.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps generate and edit images using Gemini Flash image preview through the inference.sh CLI.

faq.question: Do I need an inference.sh account?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated account.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents image editing with supported image inputs, including multiple images.

faq.question: Does it use network access?
faq.answer: Yes. It sends requests through inference.sh and can enable Google Search grounding when requested.

faq.question: Can it request 4K images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents 4K as a request option when supported by the model.

faq.question: Is automatic installation recommended?
faq.answer: The audit flags a remote pipe-to-shell install command. Review the installer and prefer manual verification before installation.
